text: Dense retrieval represents queries and documents as vectors in an embedding space. It retrieves relevant documents by comparing vector similarity.
Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) retrieves external documents and supplies their content to a language model to help it generate evidence-based answers.
A ranking metric evaluates the order in which a retrieval system places relevant documents. Mean Reciprocal Rank rewards systems that rank the first relevant result highly.
Photosynthesis is the process by which plants use sunlight, water, and carbon dioxide to produce sugars and release oxygen.
